title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

title: Traces of Justice
overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

title: Dust
overview: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Pardon
overview: Middle-aged couple Shen Mo and Tian Yi, facing their third seven-year itch, see their marriage erupt in a bitter clash of accumulated frustration, culminating in a 30-day cooling-off period that seems destined to conclude their relationship.

title: Somethin' Stupid
overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

title: The Shadow
overview: After committing a crime, Santiago and his brother take refuge in an isolated house, where they hold a woman hostage and encounter other unsettling inhabitants. What seemed like a hiding place soon turns into a labyrinth of darkness.

title: Stream of Terror
overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

title: Watching People Watching Birds
overview: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

title: Un-static
overview: A young man summons a Unicorn in search of answers about identity, belonging and purpose, embarking on a magical journey between the weight of the past and the promise of the future.

title: Baththa
overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two, changing their lives forever.

title: 新大头儿子和小头爸爸之天眼系列：失控的第七天
Edwin: In Technicolor
overview: When struggling TV salesman Edwin’s life begins to fall apart, he is forced to navigate and confront the absurdity of his life.

title: Accursed
overview: When a nun’s cursed secret resurfaces on Emma’s 21st birthday, a lake-house reunion turns deadly. A masked cult and dark prophecy force Emma and her friends to face possession, betrayal, and a midnight ritual that could raise ancient evil.

title: Особый пациент
overview: Brilliant plastic surgeon Berladin takes on the most challenging case of his career—restoring the face of the disfigured sergeant major, Perkhun. While helping his patient find hope for the future, the doctor unexpectedly encounters his own family secret. These circumstances upend his life, forcing him to radically reassess his past and concepts of goodness and justice. The fates of the surgeon and his patient become inextricably intertwined, and the trials they face force each to choose between duty, love, and the right to start anew.

title: Orang Perang
overview: The struggles of the Senoi Praaq team, a secret unit under the Royal Malaysian Police (PDRM) made up of the Orang Asli community, specifically the Semai and Temiar tribes.

title: The Hole, 309 Days to the Bloodiest Tragedy
overview: When a spate of gruesome killings rocks the countryside in East Jakarta, army officer Soegeng is tasked with clearing up rumours about the military’s involvement. Soegeng’s investigation, however, confronts him with the foundations of corruption – a truth too close for comfort.

title: Thella Kaagitham
overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

title: Born Invincible
overview: A widowed mother trains her two sons in a mysterious martial art form to protect their village.

title: Warga Rusun 609
overview: The idiosyncratic tenants of a public housing complex must form a unified front to resist an aggressive municipal demolition plan, all while covertly managing a severe supernatural haunting inside Room 609 by an aggrieved spirit demanding an unfulfilled romantic vow.

title: Corpus Delicti
overview: In the near future, the “method” controls the health and freedom of society. The life of neuroscientist Mia Holl, who is loyal to the system, changes abruptly when her brother Moritz Holl is wrongly accused of murder and imprisoned. In the fight for truth and justice, Mia begins to question the system and becomes the hunted herself.

title: 111 Echoes from Halifax
overview: Traces the stories of characters affected by the Swissair flight 111 crash, which happened off the coast of Nova Scotia, near the entrance of Margaret’s Bay, on September 2, 1998.

title: Black Market
overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

title: How Can I Help
overview: In 2030, retired actress Mrs. Winkler lives bitterly and marked by pain. When her daughter Emi accepts a theater offer, a care robot named Pavlovich takes over the care of her mother. Unexpectedly, his knowledge of classical plays seems to reawaken Mrs. Winkler's will to live...

title: What We Missed
overview: After being blindsided by sudden breakups, two heartbroken friends agree to spend a week fulfilling the bucket-list dates they never got to share with their exes

title: The Little Mammoth
overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

title: Toutes Directions
overview: When a 71-year-old regional taxi driver hears that he is losing his beloved job, he decides to take a different turn with his worn-out van full of regular passengers. The journey that follows, in which no passenger is left untouched, turns out to be exactly what he needs to start the rest of his life.

title: Mendocino
overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

title: De Grote Sinterklaasfilm en de Razende Robot
De Grote Sinterklaasfilm en de Vliegende Pieten
Phoneia
overview: In a world, where phones dominate our daily lives, we tend to miss out on other aspects of life. We miss opportunities to have meaningful interactions and underappreciate the nature surrounding us.

title: Infirmary
overview: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
overview: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

title: Backpay
overview: Backpay follows Steve, a desperate father fighting to save his marriage, who teams up with Murphy, a cop scarred by life as an informant. Their “simple” extortion plot—kidnap a corrupt politician and crack a safe—quickly spirals into danger.

title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

title: The Last First: Winter K2
overview: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

title: Repo
overview: After his last job went wrong, local fixer John is trying to get out of the game. His criminal boss, Indiana Slim, refuses to give John his final payment unless he does one final job, leaving John with two options: complete one last job, or leave empty handed

title: French Fries
overview: Years after abandoning the film they once dreamed of making together, two old friends reunite on the set of a television series. As they prepare french fries in a trailer, memories, old ambitions and long-buried disappointments resurface. Their conversation gradually becomes a confrontation with the choices, compromises and excuses that have shaped their lives, raising a simple question: Do we give up on our dreams because we change, or do we change because we give up on our dreams?

title: Nickels
overview: A successful entrepreneur and family man is involved in a bike accident involving his neighbor's son, triggering memories of his older brother's tragic death 30 years earlier.

title: Foka
overview: Dr. Dimitri Foka, a Greek doctor from Turkey, survives a Nazi execution in Greece during World War II thanks to his Turkish passport. After graduating, he returns to his hometown, the island of Imroz (Gökçeada), part of Turkey, and becomes the island’s only doctor for many years. Following the Cyprus problem in 1964, state policies targeting the Greek population lead to dispossession, violence, and forced migration on the island, yet Foka refuses to leave.

title: Changul: The Grip
overview: Set against the backdrop of the Gen-Z movement and the circumstances leading up to it, the film portrays a young generation refusing to remain silent in the face of growing challenges and despair.

title: The Children of Kozara
overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horrors of concentration camp Jasenovac.

title: Stranglehold
overview: Bailey is an exotic dancer with big dreams. She and her Army vet husband Tim are fed up with their lives of barely getting by in small-town Arkansas, so they decide to rob the strip club that employs her.

title: Despedirse
overview: After a tragic event, Noah must take a road trip to say goodbye.

title: Try!
overview: Four Irish Rugby teams who defy stereotypes tackle their way to the Mixed Ability Rugby World Cup, where full-contact sport meets joyful belonging.

title: Le Grand Bêtisier - 50 Ans de Rire
Lizzie Borden: The Hatchet House
overview: Troubled gothic teenager Ellie feels isolated, angry, and betrayed by her fractured family. Seeking connection and understanding, she turns to the legend of Lizzie Borden, the infamous axe murderer of Fall River.

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

title: Prem Keetanu
overview: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

title: Ferret-Man
overview: After buying a video game from a yard sale, a guy inputs a cursed cheat code that sends the character out of the game, seeking freedom.

title: The Influencer Project
overview: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

title: Blood Money
overview: In the Albanian port city of Durrës, Arion, a former inmate, is released from prison to fight in illegal bare-knuckle bouts at the notorious venue «The Circle» on behalf of Ilir, who is heavily in debt. Club owner Hans is initially skeptical of Arion. However, as Arion attracts more and more attention, Hans recognizes his commercial potential as well. What begins as a way out of poverty turns into a risky game when Ilir becomes involved in an illegal betting ring.

title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
overview: Suri, a magician, accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

title: Quarter Century
overview: Quarter Century is a quiet exploration of a universal yet deeply personal question: What does it truly mean to exist?

title: Avaraachan & Sons
overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

title: Appofeniacs
overview: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

title: Betty
overview: Upon discovering her grandmother Betty’s poems, Oriana attempts to piece together her image in order to understand her own identity. Delving into her family’s past, she reflects on legacy, family, and absence. What remains of us when we leave?

title: Closure
overview: Three friends must come together to settle their differences when their lack of romantic connection causes one of them to act out.

title: Expectation
overview: In a remote village of Anatolia, the dead body of a female doctor creates a deep curiosity among the villagers. The shepherd who didn’t confess his treatment because of his social fear, becomes the main suspect of the incident. Meanwhile for the lawyer the village he visited coincidentally to find peace gradually turns into darkness of expectations which are manipulating the truth or maybe it’s the truth hiding somewhere closer no one dares to look.

title: Sigma
overview: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

title: Kikuyu Land
overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

title: She Did It
overview: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.

title: Reteté
overview: The 1990s. A radiant, indomitable girl is medicated until she becomes the well-behaved child the church demands. To reclaim the daughter she once knew, her mother must confront her congregation, her family, and even God.

title: Pooja Meri Jaan
overview: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

title: Too Tight to Move
overview: A young traveler tries out a brand-new, top of the line massage chair.

title: Orion
overview: A NASA interrogator is tasked with helping an amnesiac astronaut recover his memory in order to determine “who” or “what” killed the rest of the crew before they crash-landed back on Earth.

title: Impure
overview: A dramedy about a woman whose wedding gets called off once her in-laws find out she’s not a virgin

title: Anbil Avan
overview: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.

title: Dirty Laundry
overview: A writer faces the reality of life after college.

title: Tills stjärnorna faller ner
overview: Sylvia and Marek are getting married. It's a scorching summer day and the entire family is gathered. But when the drink starts flowing and the dancing begins love is put to the test, loyalties are questioned and secrets are revealed.

title: Shakira Live from Madrid
overview: This musical release from pop singer Shakira captures a live performance by the artist, recorded live in Madrid. Proudly presented by Amazon Music.

title: Go for Broke 2
overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

title: A Knight to Remember
overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

title: GANGSTALKER!
overview: A young reptilian is sent to earth on a mission to hunt incels.

title: Amped
overview: A dysfunctional and toxic rock band is barely being held together by their stressed-out manager. With one last concert to impress a record label and get signed, the band's future hangs in the balance as tensions threaten to tear them apart.

title: Area Codes
overview: A girl from Stockton, Gabriella, breaks up with her boyfriend of 4 years and decides to help her best friend move to Los Angeles as a short getaway. At the biggest night market in LA, he meets a boy who was born and raised in SoCal, Jayson, and he shows her iconic and sentimental places within every area code of the greater LA area.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: PASTIS
overview: Sasha, 20, returns to her family’s sun-soaked home in the south of France with her friends—her first visit since her older sister’s death. What begins as an idyllic summer escape slowly curdles into something far more suffocating.

title: Pact
overview: In an attempt to lose weight, a heartbroken woman is consensually blackmailed by a dominatrix.

title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

title: Sola
overview: A young woman who suffers from chronic sleep paralysis awakens to find the world around her has descended into a zombie apocalypse.

title: Upside Down
overview: After the loss of his most beloved, Ku the rabbit must face a new reality—literally turned upside down—accompanied by a magical being that will help him navigate his grief and the coldest winter of his life.

title: On the Other Side of the Bridge are the Things I Never Said
overview: After years apart, Mora reconnects with Luna—the great, unconfessed love of her youth—hoping to rekindle the friendship they once shared. During dinner, Luna reveals she had secretly been in love with her; this long-held silence brings to the surface buried feelings and questions about what might have been.

title: You Don't Know My Name
overview: Separated from his incarcerated mother at birth, the filmmaker searches for her identity and uncovers deep ancestral bloodlines. As he gets closer to this life-altering truth, he navigates his way through systems designed to keep him in the dark.

title: Better Future
overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

title: The Metropolitan Opera: Così fan tutte
Father Father
overview: Khader and Aviv, a Muslim-Jewish gay couple, dream of starting a family. Yet, amid the joy of pregnancy and the rise of far-right extremism and war propaganda, they are forced to confront a difficult question: What does it mean to bring a child into a world torn by conflict?

title: Fatherhood
overview: Devoted soon-to-be father Lee grapples with work-family balance and self-doubt, but a surprising connection with a regular customer awakens a longing for the fatherly bond he never had.

title: Iron Tie
overview: When the world casts an iron tie for you, one that doesn't quite fit or feel right: Is it possible to dream of freedom?

title: Друзья детства
overview: Dasha is flying to another country, but just before her departure, she stops by to say goodbye to her childhood friend Fedya, who is transforming an abandoned factory into escape rooms. While touring the deserted spaces, Dasha reminisces about her childhood and risks missing her flight.

title: Little Pieces
overview: Alice returns to her estranged aunt's home to collect family photographs after her death. This simple errand unearths a buried family secret, pieced together from fragmented visions and stilted conversations with her mother. Reeling from the discovery, Alice reflects on what we inherit from our families and what we release.

title: Same Guy
overview: Five Guys had his heart. Michael Jackson had his feet.

title: Jenny
overview: Jenny, a young software professional from a coastal village in Kerala, returns home to spend a few days with her family before leaving for work. When a renovation forces her estranged grandfather back into her life, long-buried memories begin to resurface.

title: Dragoons
overview: The documentary delves into the images that shaped the political myth of Jair Bolsonaro, from his earliest YouTube videos to the end of his term in office. Over a series of sleepless nights, a narrator drifts through Bolsonaro’s livestreams, selfies, and speeches, searching for the logic of a form of power forged through and by images. By confronting this visual regime with Brazil’s official iconography, the film explores how power is understood, repeated, and asserted through images, at a time when politics increasingly unfolds on screens.

title: Terri & Richard
overview: In 1960s New York City, Terri Thal was a manager of folk musicians, including Bob Dylan, while Richard Kostelanetz was a pioneer in the literary avant-garde. Now, sixty years later, they've met online and fallen in love.

title: El Círculo
overview: After several failed attempts to contact Juliet through a ritual. Leo, Taurus and Aquarius will have to face the consequences of their betrayals and lies.

title: Monster of The Sea Guard
overview: Stranded and unconscious at sea, then waking up from her fainting and not knowing the cause, a woman (26) has to escape from a masked human figure who feels frightening to her.

title: Barbizon
overview: A stalled sculptor, on the verge of giving up art to study law with her on-again boyfriend, escapes to the Hamptons and takes a job teaching chess to wealthy families.

title: Hot Wieners and Coffee Milk
overview: On the night before Halloween in a small New England town, a local hot wiener delivery driver attempts to get out of work on time for a holiday tradition he’s kept since childhood. Things prove difficult as he navigates car troubles, a rival pizza delivery driver, and a cast of lonely regulars all keeping him stuck.

title: Adore Him
overview: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

title: Matchbox the Movie
overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween
overview: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.

title: Hurricane
overview: Manuel, a young filmmaker, seeks help from his friend Facundo to develop his script. Together they make the story come to life and the characters become independent. However, at the end, different possible paths arise that strain their relationship.

title: Contrapunto
overview: Luca is a teenager who loses his mother. On her deathbed, she gives him two letters: one for him and another for Ángel, his father, a renowned jazz musician whom Luca has never met. We follow Luca throughout the day as, motivated by his mother’s letter, he decides to deliver the letter to Ángel in an attempt to establish a bond with his father.

title: Por ahí
overview: Nacho, Benja’s best friend, is gone. In his place, there is only an obscure object. Benja waits for him, trying to decipher the clues he left behind. But even if Nacho does return, there is no certainty that he will be the same as before.

title: The World Facing Us: ICE, the Manhunt
overview: ICE: three letters long unfamiliar to the general public. Established in 2003 in response to the 9/11 attacks, this federal agency—part of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)—is responsible for enforcing immigration and customs laws.

title: Завтра
overview: Pavel is mired in debt and in desperate need of money. His creditors are determined to collect what is owed—at any cost and as soon as possible. Driven by desperation, Pavel decides to take a risk; borrowing his wife’s car under the pretext of celebrating his son’s birthday, he seizes a final chance to make some easy money.

title: Lippenstift
overview: Tomorrow is the funeral of Benedicte’s stepfather. She is 43, a psychologist, and a mother. She has to deal with her children’s anxieties about what to wear, see her patients before leaving, prepare sandwiches for the trip, and put up with her husband’s sarcasm. So far, she’s holding it together.

title: Gaspi: Camino a la Velada
overview: Gaspi flees the city, but he cannot escape his destiny. He agrees to take part in a boxing match solely for the money, placing himself at the mercy of his new trainer, Sergio Bara. Together, they will experience moments that are funny, bizarre, and dreamlike, guided by a single motto: “Hit… and don’t get hit.”

title: The Substitute
overview: In the midst of Carnival, taxi driver Manoel finds a sex toy in his living room. Huge and still sticky, the object sets off a tragicomic journey that shakes his imagination and challenges his sense of masculinity.

title: Shush
overview: A bookstore employee faces off with a silent stalker on Halloween night.

title: Damilola Taylor: The Untold Story
overview: Ten-year-old Damilola Taylor was fatally stabbed in 2000 in a stairwell in Peckham, South East London, just metres from his home. 'Star Wars' star John Boyega, who also grew up in Peckham, speaks for the first time about being one of the last people to see him alive, sharing the fear and uncertainty that followed in the aftermath of Taylor's death. Boyega is joined by close friends and family members of Taylor, who reveal the events that led to his death and talk for the first time about the impact his tragic murder has had in shaping their lives.

title: Sweet Vampire
overview: Santiago goes out for the first time after a messy breakup and meets Marcelo, who awakens long-hidden desires, but their encounter spirals out of control following an attack by a mysterious creature.

title: Two or three things I still have of hers
overview: One morning Nicolás wakes up to a letter from his girlfriend telling him that she's leaving him. Among the few things he still has of her is her cat, Ricardo. Disoriented and lost in the uncertainty, Nicolás will take the path that the people around him, the city and fate itself lead him on.

title: Dollhouse
overview: A statuesque starlet meets with the headshot photographer she found in a newspaper listing.

title: Last Chance Motel
overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.

title: Charlie Shaw's Revenge
overview: A group of workers preparing for the re-opening of a remote adventure park on the brink of bankruptcy, find themselves stalked by a silent killer. Cut off from any form of rescue, the survivors must band together to fight for their lives.

title: La nuit où Laurier Gaudreault s'est réveillé
Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: The Social Reckoning
overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

title: Vampire Carnival
overview: When a grief-stricken young woman visits a mysterious, traveling carnival in her small town, she becomes seduced into a dangerous world of pleasure and deception.

title: Stain
overview: Haunted by trauma, a psychologically unstable teenager is compelled to visit his sick grandmother with his half-sister and their friends. Being back in his childhood home, his dark past resurfaces, forcing him to confront whether the true horror lies in the island - the people from his past, or within himself.

title: Almari
overview: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

title: Love of Your Life
overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

title: Who Is Martin Mull?
overview: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

title: Matloub Aaeleyan
overview: Farouk, a supermarket manager, is so consumed by his work that he has little time for his wife, Mai, and their children. His unemployed brother-in-law, Galal, comes to live with the family and completely turns Farouk's life upside down, dragging him into a series of hilarious troubles and impossible situations.

title: Видеопрокат
overview: The steady, uneventful life of Roma, a lonely ninth-grader, is disrupted by Polina—a rebellious older student who is constantly getting into wild escapades. Together, they attempt to unravel the mystery of a mystical VHS tape—number seven—rented from a local video store. Drawn into a dangerous adventure and growing genuinely close, they have no idea what kind of choice the investigation’s conclusion will force them to make.

title: Calming Winds
overview: Struggling with his smoking addiction, Rich has to quit smoking before his partner Char leaves him. Searching on the internet for solutions he finds a peculiar pop up add that'll grant him his wish, by removing Rich's ability to create a flame.

title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
overview: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: Butterfly Jam
overview: 16 years old Pyteh splits his time between the wrestling mat and his family’s struggling Circassian diner in Newark. A single impulsive decision by his hustling father changes the course of his life, shaping a tale of pride, legacy, and masculinity.

title: Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint-Potache
overview: It’s Halloween, and Ducobu is back for an adventure filled with laughter and mystery! Professor Latouche and Miss Rateau move into a house haunted by the ghost of Anatole, the biggest dunce in the history of Saint-Potache School. This mischievous ghost will drag Ducobu, Léonie, their parents, and Kitrish into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures. But beware: on Halloween, anything can happen!

title: Reveal
overview: A hard drive found at an archaeological site in Méier—an old suburb of what was known as Rio de Janeiro—reveals previously unseen images of the preparations for a festive ritual celebrated during the Years of the Outbreak: the gender reveal party.

title: Pentimento
overview: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

title: Family Wanted
overview: The film follows an Interpol agent who takes on a complex joint mission with one of his female colleagues. During the mission, he is forced to encounter unexpected characters, setting off a series of situations, crises, and unforeseen twists.

title: Too Many Beasts
overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

title: Angel and the Badman
overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

title: The Beast
overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

title: The Spiral
overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

title: Happily Married
overview: Anis and Anamika are complete opposites, brought together by an unexpected marriage. Can the responsible Anis and the free-spirited, modern Anamika overcome their differences and build a happy life together?

title: Camouflage
overview: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

title: The Sandbox
overview: In Singapore, a stuntman teams up with his brother and ex-sister-in-law to keep their declining stunt school alive. Just as their dream seems about to fade, a rumour that Marvel Studios is scouting locally brings a surge of wannabe superheroes and misfits to their doorstep, convinced they’ll be whipped into crime-fighting shape.

title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
overview: How far would you go to change a child the world can’t understand? One autistic artist survives a hidden system of abuse built to correct her.

title: Voices Inside Your Head
overview: Diverse individuals (a demolition expert, a visagist, a physicist, an Indigenous leader, and a Santo Daime priest) recount how psychedelics transformed their lives in unexpected and profound ways.

title: If I Were You 3
overview: Two decades after their last body swap, Cláudio and Helena are living a new phase of their lives alongside their daughter Bia, now an adult and married with Aquiles. Everything seems balanced until an unexpected situation shakes up the family dynamic and puts their relationships to the test. When lightning seems to strike the same place again, the whole family is forced to learn to put themselves in each other's shoes, in a very literal way.

title: Don't
overview: Two women, Morgan and Rea, relive their past relationship through a series of fragmented memories, revealing not just the past, but the distance between them now.

title: Ibuku
overview: A destitute widow and former traditional dancer defies social ostracization to embark on a desperate international journey, seeking a final reconciliation with her estranged daughter who faces execution abroad for the murder of an abusive employer.

title: Rough Draft
overview: Much to his wife’s chagrin, Michael can’t seem to settle on the ending to his latest novel. Even though he has owed the publisher for some time now, he keeps deleting and tweaking the ending to his tale of horror, with each change ultimately affecting the outcome of the group of teens who are being killed one by one by an unknown killer in his story.

title: Föa - Once Upon A Future
overview: Nicole, alone at home while pregnant during the G8 demonstrations in Genoa, unwisely opens the door to a group of protesters. During the forced cohabitation, the private world of the woman and the public world of the boys collide and end up changing each other.

title: Šipkaři
overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.

title: Found Alive
overview: Reeve LeClaire is still haunted by when she was held captive as a teenager by a sadistic man, but when her psychiatrist asks her to mentor a newly rescued survivor, she’s pulled into a chilling game of cat-and-mouse—one that threatens to drag her back into the nightmare she barely escaped.

title: PSYCHO
overview: When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes. Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

title: The Pastor Who Preys
overview: Budding fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. When Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry
overview: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

title: First Witch
overview: A couple journey to a small town to visit a traditional healer for alternative conception methods, when they soon discover the dark secrets of the town's past.

title: Processing Charlie
overview: An act of kindness quickly becomes a nightmarish fight for survival when a young man, dealing with his fractured marriage, takes in a needy, long-lost cousin. Part pervert, part psychopath, Cousin Cole’s dark secrets slowly bubble to the surface as Charlie realizes too late that no good deed goes unpunished.

title: The Tribe
overview: Silvano just wants to celebrate his wife Tere's birthday in peace, but his plan is ruined when his chaotic and contentious family shows up.

title: Tunnel 26: The Curse Beneath the Mountain
overview: When an event triggers a blockage of tunnel in a hydro power project in Bhutan, frantic rescue teams from Nepal and Bhutan race against time to save the trapped workers and students unaware that an ancient gate has been unsealed and the survivors are battling not just the rubble, but a rising tide of possession and karmic doom.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: The Mage
overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

title: Wen er maar aan
overview: Actress M. is facing menopause, loses her long-running role in a crime series, has to deal with an apathetic teenage son, and her sex life is as dry as toast. She tries to reinvent herself, to prove to herself and to the world that she still has a future ahead of her.

title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

title: Street Angel
overview: A hustler finds hope through his relationship with a faithful woman, until his violent past catches up with them. Set between barbershop, church, and streets, their story explores redemption's price.

title: Prince
overview: A devoted butler inherits his late employer's mansion - but only until her cherished Afghan Greyhound dies. As he settles in with the dog, greedy relatives scheme to disrupt their peaceful arrangement.

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Oh Season
overview: Felix McCoy is a young boy grappling with the loss of his mother, the beloved creator of the town’s annual holiday pageant. When the production is hijacked and rebranded into a shallow spectacle by cocksure director Hamilton Lydell, Felix secretly sabotages the event, only to realize that saving the show might be the only way to keep his late mother’s spirit alive.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Reporting Live
overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

title: V/H/S/Mixtape
overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

title: You, Like a Star
overview: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

title: Comrade Kalyan
overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

title: Tenzing
overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Musk
overview: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

title: Teambuilding 2
overview: After barely surviving a team-building retreat that tested not only their social skills but also their mental health, Horia and the gang are now part of an elite team trying to sell a groundbreaking new product: AI de PLM.

title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
overview: Sam and Becka race to stop a new Pumpkinhead curse from claiming the entire town of Redhaven.

title: Resonance
overview: When archaeologist Clara Hartley discovers her family's century-old secret to manipulate time, she must confront her estranged past and an inter-dimensional threat to save her daughter's future and the fabric of reality itself.

title: Bonded
overview: When two sisters return to their childhood home after their elderly parents untimely death, they are forced to confront the disturbing truths hidden in the walls of the house. As their past comes to light, reality begins to distort, threatening to unravel their sanity.

title: Double Trouble
overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

title: Apocalypse Z: New World
overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

title: Medeni Haller
overview: Between love, marriage, and freedom, everyone has a “marital status.”

title: Melancholy
overview: A lonely and depressed young man decides to start beating up delinquents on the streets to cope with his sadness. People call him “Melancholy.”

title: A Prayer for the Dying
overview: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

title: Misty Green
overview: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

title: Santo
overview: A traffic accident brings two young delivery riders together in São Paulo. Yuri, free-spirited and provocative, and Davi, hardworking and guided by his faith, find themselves caught between religion and the freedom of the streets.

title: The Cord
overview: Kuanysh, who is about to enroll at an American university, is the pride of his single mother, Dinara. Divorced when Kuanysh was young, Dinara has devoted herself to caring for her son, but as a teenager he has a world his mother is not privy to. One day, Kuanysh goes to a club with his friends and becomes involved in an assault incident, which turns into a homicide when the victim dies during the investigation. The wealthy and influential parents of Kuanysh’s friends attempt to make him the culprit, and now Dinara must protect her son by her own means.

title: Petros Eni
overview: In an immersion into the little-known Necropolis upon which the foundations of St. Peter's Basilica rest, we will learn the story of the tomb of the first apostle. The first Pope, the "rock" upon which all of Christianity was built and which has cemented the history not only of the Catholic religion, but of all Western civilization. A fascinating journey through a sacred place that has survived for millennia and whose history is intertwined with the life of the apostle himself and the construction of the Basilica, which in 2026, when Petros Eni arrives in the rooms, will celebrate the 400th anniversary of its inauguration.

title: The Double
overview: On New Years Eve, Investigator Oleg is asked to check out a case at his own apartment building where he discovers Santa Claus has been looking for him in this mind bending animation.

title: All Pass
overview: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

title: Devour
overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: Elza
overview: With her radical voice, visceral improvisation, and unmistakable rasp, Elza Soares created a language all her own and crossed generations, continually reinventing herself as one of Brazil’s greatest artists. In the documentary that bears her name, Elza narrates her own story, weaving together a diary of memories, desires, and reflections through music, in dialogue with historic Brazilian films. Through Elza and her nearly century-long life, the film offers an X-ray of a country in turmoil.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Explore Freedom
overview: Six people. Three routes. And a journey that changed everything.  Explore Freedom is a gravel cycling film produced by El Flamingo Film, presented by Rose Bikes about keeping an open mind, embracing the unknown and discovering what happens when people connect through adventure and cycling.  Join Marcel Kittel, Burak Öztürk, Sami Sauri, Tsellot Melesse, Petor Georgallou and Sara van Vliet on an unforgettable bike packing adventure across Europe. From the first intimate moments at the start line not knowing anyone to the emotional finale in Pula, Explore Freedom tells a story about cycling, human connection and discovering freedom beyond borders.

title: Bloodline
overview: An ancient curse with roots in Egypt resurfaces in a mysterious Istanbul mansion. Summoned to the estate by his dying grandfather, Can and his friends are soon forced to confront the mansion's dark secrets and a supernatural threat.

title: Waves Turn
overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

title: Illegal Aliens
overview: A group of migrants crossing the U.S.-Mexico border are spotted by Border Patrol agents hiding a terrible secret...

title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026
overview: The 2026 Money in the Bank, also promoted as Money in the Bank: New Orleans, is an upcoming professional wrestling premium live event produced by WWE. It will be the 17th annual Money in the Bank event and will take place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, in New Orleans, Louisiana. This will be the first Money in the Bank to be held in October, making it the latest scheduled Money in the Bank in a calendar year, and the first one to be held after SummerSlam.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: Termination Point
overview: An alcoholic is faced with her inner demons after sleeping past her stop home on the bus.

title: The Spirit of Halloween
overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

title: Skin Writing
overview: Particles accumulate under the skin, causing itching and hives that follow the unsuspected lines of unnoticed scratches, minor scrapes, or bumps. Skin writing is an attempt to understand these glyphs that rush to the surface of the skin to project something onto my skin, from the inside out.

title: To Catch A Siren
overview: A young refugee desperately searches for her mother, who she believes to be a mermaid.

title: Cement
overview: A nightclub owner struggles to balance her work life with her romantic life over the course of one chaotic evening, and is ultimately forced to choose between past and present love.

title: Night Shift
overview: A near-future dystopia. During his first shift guarding the coastline, a young cadet has to confront the enemy whilst dealing with his retiring mentor who has a love for cake.

title: A Season
overview: Eric, a young Bali based heir used to a life of ease, until Sonya’s motorbike collides with his car on a coastal road. Sharp, unpredictable, and playing by her own rules, Sonya pulls Eric into a relationship that blurs every boundary he thought he understood. As their connection intensifies, Eric is forced to face a truth he has spent his life avoiding: nothing lasts forever, not wealth, not pleasure, not even love.

title: ephemeral
overview: Ivy wants to avoid speaking about a traumatic situation with her mother, so she forces herself into a simulated reality that takes place in her own mind. Here she is met with her supposed paradise, but that doesn’t last long, because her trauma is so deeply rooted that it begins to seep through the simulation. She faces several manifestations of her inner thoughts in the form of real, tangible people who convince her that she is better off here, but she can’t help but feel as though her paradise has turned into something that is worse than the feelings she is trying to escape.

title: Between Summers
overview: Between french fries, TikToks, and sunscreen, carefree moments clash with self-doubt, and playful freedom with societal pressure. This is the vibrant world of adolescents searching for their place – on the lawn and in life. When the orange slide is torn down, the chapter of childhood comes to an end. Two years later, after the renovation, it's not just the public pool that has changed.

title: The Cryonicist
overview: When her boyfriend is taken off life support by his family, a brilliant but obsessive college student risks everything to steal his body and DIY cryogenically freeze him.

title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
overview: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.

title: Always Lalisa
overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

title: Clown Panic
overview: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

title: Awake
overview: Based on his writings from a sleepless night in U.S. immigration detention, Mahmoud Khalil reflects on being separated from his family and the fragile promises of democracy, justice, and human dignity.

title: The Child
overview: Thirty-seven-year-old Zane and Kaspars seem to have it all – love, careers, a home, and shared hobbies. Still, for a decade, they have been unable to have a child. After trying fertility clinics, diets, churches, and healers, Kaspars is slowly coming to terms with the idea that life can be fulfilling even without children. Meanwhile, Zane cannot accept the thought of not becoming a mother and is ready to go to any lengths to make it happen.

title: Street Fighter
overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

title: Agia
overview: In the 1990s, Albania's totalitarian regime is coming to an end. Agia, a young woman in a remote village still ruled by rigid codes of honour and silence, is barred from learning her family's craft. In her first act of defiance, she secretly begins mastering the tradition reserved for men. When this plunges her into a wider world, Agia dares to assert not only work and visibility, but also her own desires. Her belated coming of age becomes a quiet rebellion, mirroring that of a nation struggling to redefine itself.

title: John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
overview: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon.

title: Pomegranate
overview: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman unravels the boundaries between love, violence, and desire, discovering that the deepest form of intimacy may demand the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Whalefall
overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

title: Jailer 2
overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

title: Minotaur
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

title: Iron Boy
overview: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

title: The Scale
overview: Dawson, a submissive people-pleaser, must cut ties with his vanity-ridden friend group led by the conniving Cade.

title: 2 Valid IDs
overview: A poor farmer, unable to claim a remittance because she lacks the required two valid IDs, finds herself in a situation that challenges her character, beliefs, and morality.

title: Horizon
overview: As the twilight of adolescence gives way to adulthood, Casca, Ana, and Fú find themselves stalled on the roadside. The highway shifts before their eyes: a reverse road movie.

title: Lady Liberty: Secrets of an Icon
overview: This iconic statue was a gift from France to the new-born American Republic and was the first crowd-funded monument of all time. A symbol of emancipation and freedom, which took two decades to be completed. The film features original 3D virtual reconstitutions of Auguste Bartholdi’s Atelier in Paris and travels back in time to bring viewers at the heart of the Statue’s original construction, revealing the founding ideals of our democracies.

title: Home, Almost
overview: A story about an MMA fighter who finds himself in another fight on the way home. — with his father and younger brother by his side, finding the true meaning of family along the way.

title: Fat
overview: A father obsessed with his own physique decides to force his overweight son to slim down, to the point of no return.

title: GALDR
overview: After joining GALDR, a dating app for magical folk, a young man posing as a Druid matches with a mysterious witch for a seemingly ordinary first date. But as the night unfolds, he's pulled into a world of danger and magical chaos far beyond what he could have ever expected.

title: Ghosthing
overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

title: Pemuja Syaitan
overview: Just months after finishing school, former classmates, Khatijah, Ana, Marissa, Nazim, P and Julie reunite in their coastal hometown. Tagging along are Halim, P's cousin and Amira, Nazim's Current Conquest. The night takes a dark turn when they dig up a time capsule they buried sometime ago. Tension begins to rise. unspoken betrayals, fractured trust, and painful memories resurface, as the night unleash a terror unseen and unknown. The morning after, Inspector Zul is dispatched to the island, and witnesses something he hasn't seen before. six dead bodies, a missing ana and a traumatised khatijah. He enters a nightmare more intimate than expected one which includes a ritual site. Khatijah helps Inspector Zul piece together their night of terror. As he sets his foot deeper into the island, he realises nothing is what it seems, and the truth might cost him his soul.

title: The Disenchantment
overview: In a remote village in the Pyrenees, Inés discovers that the relocation of an ancient church is only the beginning of an immersion into a magical and ancestral world that will change her perception of life and death.

title: Back Scratch
overview: Two friends explore old and new intimacy over a New Mexico Christmas weekend.

title: The Ambitious
overview: The year is 2023, and elections are nearing in Goma, a Congolese city of one million people situated near the border with genocide-ravaged Rwanda. It is a region rich in valuable natural resources, where bloody conflicts over ethnic and economic issues have been raging for three decades, devastating eastern Congo. Two members of the La Lucha civil society movement decide to abandon activism in favour of a career in politics. Espoir, a young activist, stands as a candidate for the National Assembly on behalf of the opposition. Sankara who, confined to a wheelchair, has become a symbol of resistance, joins the outgoing president’s coalition. When rebel troops from the M23 group enter Goma, their dreams of democracy are thrown into doubt.

title: Opt Out
overview: Four friends from a long-buried crime are brought back together by a coded text, only to learn that the secret they thought was safe has come unraveled.

title: The Storm
overview: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be trapped together. Their polished acts fall, and an unfiltered meltdown starts. When the panic starts to creep in and they all realise the seriousness of the situation, the farm starts to shrink, secrets spill out, and unexpected feelings take shape.

title: Encryption
overview: A conspiracy theorist Theo and his niece are looking for answers about Theo's abduction. Following a path of clues left by Theo prior to his memory loss leads them to a hideout of an underground organization nicknamed "Cryp-Tech".

title: London
overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: The Lost Land
overview: The Lost Land is a short documentary about an ancient forest that sank beneath the Baltic Sea 12,000 years ago. The film follows Professor Vladas Žulkus and his team as they explore the seabed and study the remains of the trees. Their discoveries help us understand the past and reveal how climate change could reshape our coastline in the future.

title: You Can See Everything
overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

title: Ranabaali
overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

title: Masterplan
overview: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

title: Free Therapy
overview: A young Man reckons with his life alongside an eccentric Therapist, both finding different ways of coping with pain.

title: You Can't Leave
overview: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.

title: Her Song
overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

title: Cabaret Boys
overview: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

title: Zebras
overview: A young man lends his house to a friend while he is away at work, leading the friend to embark on a schizophrenic adventure.

title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Liv's Last Ride
overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

title: Nayyi Navelli
overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

title: Poniiy
overview: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

title: Nature
overview: Eight longtime friends head deep into the wilderness for an annual camping trip, hoping for a weekend away from the pressures of everyday life. But when a masked stranger emerges from the woods and brutally murders one of them, their getaway becomes a fight for survival. Trapped and surrounded by a mysterious group known as The Eyes, the remaining campers are given an impossible choice: identify a supposed traitor among them—or sacrifice one of their own each night. As fear and paranoia take hold, friendships fracture and long-buried resentments rise to the surface. With no way out and trust becoming a liability, the group must decide how far they are willing to go to survive. Because in the wilderness, the greatest threat may not be the people hunting them. It may be what they are capable of becoming.

title: Prahaar
overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Noah Silva is a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose 'do whatever it takes' approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work. After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.

title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

title: The Craft
overview: Sauro Cantafame is “the techie”: he drives solo through a lunar southern landscape in his Ape Car, in a borderland between the real and the absurd. His mission? Implant mechanical hearts in deceased oldsters, so their families can pretend they’re still alive and cash their pension checks. He offers a ride to a fragile kid in danger, whose name says it all, as far as his prospects are concerned: Giocondo Infelice. But that gesture raises the hackles of Vito ‘a scimmia, the crime lord who has full control over the territory. Cantafame teaches the kid his strange trade in death, craft, and discontent; while Giocondo breaks out of his shell and finally finds the father he never had. But Cantafame has a few skeletons in his closet and a negative karma to fulfill, which will goad him to defy Vito in order to save his young charge.

title: When Wine Meets Coffee
overview: When Claire, a sophisticated wine expert, travels to Costa Rica, her carefully ordered world collides with Alex, a passionate coffee producer deeply rooted in his family’s land. As wine and coffee, past and present, begin to intertwine, an unexpected connection challenges what they thought they knew about love, memory, and the paths that bring people together.

title: Jesaja
overview: The fifth year of the New Normal begins in 2024. Finland prepares for war. In Helsinki, Jesaja Jalonen, a remote digital worker, prepares for the run of his life.

title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
overview: The ultimate love letter to Martin Scorsese's classic film GoodFellas (1990).

title: Liquid Courage
overview: An aspiring artist is stuck as a bartender when she is encouraged by a loud, talking bottle of alcohol to throw everything away and chase her dreams.

title: Dancer of the Republic
overview: As Linda prepares to dance in a cabaret in Beirut, the end of the Lebanese Civil War is proclaimed. The announcement of the Syrian regime’s troops entering Lebanon makes Linda question whether the war has truly come to an end.

title: Half Moon
overview: Riley and Lucy used to be close friends but have since grown apart over the years. While Lucy's long-term boyfriend is away at a bachelor party, she invites Riley to spend the weekend at her family's house upstate (now converted into an Airbnb), a trip they used to take together. Both live in New York, but haven't spent extended time together in years. Unspoken tensions surface as it becomes apparent how much distance there is between the two of them. Over the course of the weekend, they find small but unexpected ways to reconnect.

title: Habituation
overview: An expectant couple is on the move, traveling through a country struck by unexpected weather phenomena.

title: Hard Stuff
overview: The band "Noble Rot" is preparing for a concert at the Secret Place.

title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Indigo Elsewhere
